capital.evidence_quote: Port-au-Prince is the capital and most populous metropolis of the Republic of Haiti

currency.evidence_quote: The Haitian Gourde (HTG, G) is the official currency; US dollars are accepted widely in commerce

timezone.evidence_quote: Haiti operates on Eastern Standard Time UTC-5, observing daylight saving time UTC-4 in summer

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential voltage is 110V 60 Hz across urban electric grids in Haiti

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Operating frequency of the national power network is 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: North American Type A and Type B plugs with two flat parallel pins are universal

police.evidence_quote: Dial 114 for emergency police response from the Police Nationale d'Haïti

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 116 for the Centre Ambulancier National emergency medical dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 115 for emergency fire and disaster response services

general.evidence_quote: 114 is the national emergency operational contact line

tourist_police.evidence_quote: POLITOUR tourist police division operates in Cap-Haïtien and designated historic zones

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Şiddetli çete çatışmaları, adam kaçırma ve güvenlik krizi nedeniyle uluslararası dışişleri bakanlıkları Haiti'ye kesinlikle seyahat edilmemesini tavsiye etmektedir.
advisory_headline.en: Do Not Travel to Haiti due to armed gang violence, kidnapping, civil unrest, and severe humanitarian crisis.
advisory_headline.de: Reisewarnung: Vor Reisen nach Haiti wird wegen extremer Bandengewalt und Entführungsgefahr dringend gewarnt.
advisory_headline.ru: Категорически не рекомендуется посещать Гаити из-за высокого уровня вооруженного насилия банд и похищений людей.
advisory_headline.es: No viaje a Haití debido a la violencia armada de pandillas, secuestros y grave crisis de seguridad.

regional_warnings.area: Port-au-Prince metropolitan area and Artibonite department

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Haiti measure approximately 18.5 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds measure 22.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Digicel Haïti and Natcom operate mobile networks. Commercial flights to Port-au-Prince (PAP) suffer frequent security suspensions; Cap-Haïtien International Airport (CAP) in the north is used as a safer regional entry point.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: SIM card purchases require passport registration under national telecommunications decrees

religion.value: Roman Catholicism (approx. 55%), Protestantism (approx. 30%), alongside widely practiced Haitian Vodou heritage

sources.title: Institut Haïtien de Statistique et d'Informatique (IHSI)

religion.evidence_quote: Haitian Vodou is an officially recognized national religion syncretized with Roman Catholic saint veneration

festivals.value: Haitian Kanaval in Jacmel (world-renowned papier-mâché masks), Rara street music parades during Lent, Ancestor Day
festivals.evidence_quote: Jacmel Carnival is celebrated for extraordinary giant papier-mâché sculptures and rich Haitian folklore

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Independent travel across Port-au-Prince is strongly discouraged due to armed gang checkpoints and high kidnapping risks. Travel should only be undertaken with vetted armed security details and verified local contacts. French and Haitian Creole (Kreyòl) are official languages.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Kidnapping is widespread and targets foreign citizens and locals alike across the metropolitan area

tipping.value: Tipping 10-15% is customary in hotels and secure restaurants in Pétion-Ville and Cap-Haïtien.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10-15% tip is standard in hospitality establishments
